zh.title: 國防部：偵獲共機3架次、共艦9艘，3架次越中線進入西南及東部空域
zh.summary: 國防部11月24日公布，自23日上午6時至24日上午6時，偵獲共機3架次，3架次均逾越海峽中線進入西南及東部空域，另有共艦9艘在臺海周邊活動。
body: 國防部11月24日上午公布中共解放軍臺海周邊海、空域動態：自11月23日上午6時至24日上午6時，偵獲共機3架次，3架次均逾越海峽中線進入西南及東部空域，另有共艦9艘持續在臺海周邊活動。國防部表示，國軍運用任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
國防部同時公布的空域活動示意圖列出兩批共機的時段與機種：上午7時10分至晚間8時30分有無人機2架次，圖上標註這2架次逾越中線；下午2時至晚間7時05分有直升機1架，活動位置標示在臺灣東部外海。
前一個統計日（11月22日上午6時至23日上午6時），國防部通報偵獲共機6架次，其中5架次逾越中線進入西南及東部空域，另有共艦12艘。

en.title: Taiwan detects 3 PLA aircraft sorties and 9 naval vessels; all 3 sorties cross the median line
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said it detected three PLA aircraft sorties in the 24 hours to 6 a.m. on November 24, all of which crossed the Taiwan Strait median line into southwestern and eastern airspace, along with nine PLA Navy vessels.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said on November 24 that it detected three sorties of People's Liberation Army (PLA) aircraft between 6 a.m. on November 23 and 6 a.m. on November 24. All three crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait and entered southwestern and eastern airspace. Nine PLA Navy vessels were also operating around Taiwan. The ministry said the armed forces monitored the situation and responded with mission aircraft, naval vessels and shore-based missile systems.

The ministry's accompanying chart lists two groups of aircraft by time and type: two sorties of unmanned aerial vehicles between 7:10 a.m. and 8:30 p.m., both marked as crossing the median line, and one helicopter between 2 p.m. and 7:05 p.m., plotted off Taiwan's east coast.

In the previous reporting period, from 6 a.m. on November 22 to 6 a.m. on November 23, the ministry reported six aircraft sorties, five of which crossed the median line into southwestern and eastern airspace, as well as 12 naval vessels.

facts.claim: Between 06:00 on November 23 and 06:00 on November 24, Taiwan detected 3 PLA aircraft sorties (3 crossing the median line into southwestern and eastern airspace) and 9 PLA Navy vessels.
The ministry's chart lists 2 UAV sorties (0710-2030, both crossing the median line) and 1 helicopter sortie (1400-1905) plotted east of Taiwan.
CNA reported the same figures from the ministry's announcement.
The previous period recorded 6 sorties (5 across the median line into southwestern and eastern airspace) and 12 vessels.
